about: Ride the city's walks (P7). Off-street walks (graph: true) are routed over the walk graph (walk-graph.json, OSM footways, the Riverwalk, the Lakefront Trail) between these waypoints. Street walks (street: true) follow the street's centreline (OSM roads) and walk its sidewalk: the build tries offsets 12–28 m to the given side and keeps the first that never enters a building footprint. Waypoints are [lat, lon].

walks.name: The Riverwalk
walks.blurb: The Chicago Riverwalk along the main branch's south bank, under the bascule bridges, from the lake to the river's bend

walks.name: The Magnificent Mile
walks.blurb: North Michigan Avenue's east sidewalk from the river past the Wrigley Building, Tribune Tower and the Water Tower to Oak Street

walks.name: The Lakefront Trail: Grant Park to the Museum Campus
walks.blurb: The Lakefront Trail south along Monroe Harbor, past Buckingham Fountain's lawns to the Field Museum and the Shedd

walks.name: Fulton Market and Restaurant Row
walks.blurb: West Randolph Street's restaurant row, then north on Morgan and back east along Fulton Market's old meatpacking blocks
sources: https://www.openstreetmap.org/ (West Randolph Street, West Fulton Market)

walks.name: Lincoln Park: the Zoo to North Pond
walks.blurb: Through Lincoln Park on its paths: the Zoo, the Lincoln Park Conservatory and the Alfred Caldwell Lily Pool, to North Pond
